messages.subject: D-RUG Work Session tomorrow...
parts:
Hi Folks,

Noam is out of town, but I'll be hosting a work session tomorrow, same time, same place (Tuesday 1:10-3 in Wickson 2124). We don't have a speaker tomorrow, but please come by whether you have questions, have work on your own projects (including classwork), or you'd simply like to eat a few cookies. It's a great place and time to get help on R and related topics from the D-RUG community. Next week I'll be talking about how to integrate Markdown documents with shiny to provide accessible tools for data analysis and reporting.

Hopefully see folks tomorrow,

Adios,
Ryan
